cartivo.title: Cartivo
cartivo.subtitle: Enterprise Commerce Platform
cartivo.description: Cartivo is a complete Enterprise Commerce Platform built for modern businesses that require scalability, automation, and seamless operations across the entire supply chain. It connects customers, distributors, warehouses, delivery riders, and enterprise systems into one intelligent ecosystem.

detailedContent.sectionTitle: More than a traditional e-commerce website
detailedContent.content: Cartivo is a complete Enterprise Commerce Platform built for modern businesses that require scalability, automation, and seamless operations across the entire supply chain. It is more than a traditional e-commerce website. It connects customers, distributors, warehouses, delivery riders, and enterprise systems into one intelligent ecosystem. The platform is designed for retailers, wholesalers, distributors, pharmaceutical companies, manufacturers, healthcare organizations, and businesses operating across multiple locations.

items.title: Customer Website
items.desc: A modern, responsive web application where customers can browse products, search categories, view detailed product information, manage their shopping cart, upload prescriptions when required, and place orders through a secure checkout process.

items.title: Customer Mobile Application
items.desc: A mobile commerce application that provides the same seamless shopping experience with real-time inventory, location-based pricing, secure ordering, and order tracking.

items.title: Distributor Portal
items.desc: A centralized portal that allows distributors to receive orders automatically, manage inventory, process customer orders, assign riders, monitor deliveries, print invoices, and manage territory-based operations.

items.title: Rider Application
items.desc: A dedicated delivery application that enables riders to receive assigned deliveries, navigate to customer locations, update delivery status, collect Cash on Delivery payments, upload proof of delivery, and complete last-mile fulfillment.

items.title: Warehouse Management
items.desc: A warehouse management module that synchronizes inventory across multiple warehouses, maintains stock availability, and supports automated order fulfillment.

detailedContent.content: The shopping experience begins when a customer opens the Cartivo website or mobile application. The customer selects a delivery location. Based on the selected location, Cartivo automatically displays products available within the customer's service area. The customer browses products, views product details, adjusts quantities, and adds products to the shopping cart. During checkout, customers provide shipping information, billing details, and can upload prescriptions for regulated products. After placing the order, the customer immediately receives order confirmation and email notification.
points: Cartivo displays products available in that service area
Customer browses, manages cart, and uploads prescriptions
Secure checkout with immediate order confirmation

detailedContent.content: Once an order is confirmed, Cartivo automatically starts its business workflow. The platform identifies the customer's delivery territory, locates the nearest warehouse, checks real-time inventory, and identifies the assigned distributor for that territory. The order is automatically routed to the correct distributor without manual intervention. This automation reduces processing time and improves operational efficiency.

items.title: Distributor Workflow
items.desc: The assigned distributor receives the order instantly. The distributor reviews the order, verifies inventory, and approves it. The distributor assigns the order to an available rider, generating the invoice while order status is continuously updated.

items.title: Rider Workflow
items.desc: The assigned rider receives the delivery request instantly. The rider views customer information, uses in-app navigation, collects COD payments, uploads proof of delivery, and marks the order as delivered, triggering a customer notification.

items.title: Real Time Inventory
items.desc: Cartivo continuously synchronizes inventory from warehouses and ERP systems. Customers always see accurate product availability. Out of stock products are updated automatically.

items.title: Dynamic Pricing
items.desc: Pricing can vary based on business rules: Territory, Warehouse, Customer type, Distributor, Promotions, and Business agreements. Customers always see the correct price.

items.title: Territory Based Distribution
items.desc: Businesses can assign distributors to specific cities, regions, or delivery territories. Orders are automatically routed according to predefined business rules.

detailedContent.content:
Cartivo integrates with virtually any business system via REST APIs. It supports ERP Systems (SAP, ERPNext, Oracle ERP, Microsoft Dynamics), CSV/Excel Imports, Supplier Systems, Accounting Software, CRM Platforms, Payment Gateways, and Logistics Providers.

Cartivo follows a modular layered architecture:
- **Presentation Layer**: Responsive web and mobile user interfaces.
- **Business Logic Layer**: Processes workflows, validations, pricing, and automation.
- **Data Access Layer**: Handles database operations securely and scalably.
- **Integration Layer**: Connects with external systems and APIs.
